technical.title: Embodied First Exam evaluates coding agents for robot control tasks
technical.summary: Researchers introduce the Embodied First Exam, a unified evaluation framework featuring 1,156 tasks across 47 robots to test if coding agents can reliably control diverse physical systems.
technical.why: It establishes standardized benchmarks for agentic robotics and physical-world AI deployment.

technical.title: RoboRisk benchmark evaluates safety risks in foundation model robot control
technical.summary: RoboRisk is a comprehensive safety benchmark featuring simulated and physical robot tasks across five critical categories to address the safety risks of foundation model-driven robotics.
technical.why: Safety evaluation is vital for deploying embodied AI and foundation models in real-world robotics safely.

technical.title: MBZUAI releases PAN 2 open 29B world model for physical AI
technical.summary: PAN 2 is an Apache 2.0 world model coupling an LLM planner with a 29B diffusion transformer to simulate up to 20 seconds of action outcomes as video.
technical.why: Large-scale physical world models are critical tools for training and predicting outcomes in robotics and autonomous systems.

technical.title: URL-Sim provides high-fidelity LiDAR simulation for dynamic driving scenes
technical.summary: URL-Sim uses 3D Gaussian splatting to achieve efficient and realistic LiDAR simulation from real-world driving logs, overcoming the rendering speed bottlenecks of prior Neural Radiance Field methods.
technical.why: Accurate sensor simulation is essential for cost-effective safety validation in autonomous driving pipelines.

technical.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 enhances real-world robot dexterity and safety
technical.summary: The updated vision-language-action model improves robotic operational reliability, safety, and general dexterity in real-world scenarios.
technical.why: Progress in vision-language-action models directly accelerates general-purpose robotic manipulation and autonomy.

technical.title: Maze Runner open autonomy stack enables robust robot maze navigation
technical.summary: Maze Runner is a C++ and ROS 2 open autonomy stack integrating line-based perception, EKF estimation, and control barrier functions to achieve safe autonomous navigation in constrained environments.
technical.why: It provides a practical reference architecture for perception-driven mobile robot localization and control.

technical.title: GEMOR-GS refines 3D Gaussian-splatting SLAM with global extrinsics
technical.summary: GEMOR-GS improves 3D Gaussian splatting SLAM systems by refining LiDAR-camera extrinsics, enabling geometrically accurate, globally consistent, and re-enterable world representations for robots.
technical.why: High-fidelity map representations directly enhance robot perception, localization, and decision-making capabilities.

technical.title: RaMOD detects moving objects from raw mmWave radar cubes
technical.summary: RaMOD is a real-time framework that processes raw range-azimuth-Doppler cubes from a single-chip automotive radar to handle ego-motion challenges and perform moving-object detection.
technical.why: It improves weather-robust perception pipelines in autonomous driving using raw radar sensor data.

technical.title: GTAGym provides AAA game environment for agent evaluation and reinforcement learning
technical.summary: GTAGym introduces an environment and benchmark derived from GTA V missions containing 103 online tasks and 47 shooting challenges to evaluate agent perception, reasoning, and control.
technical.why: Complex virtual environments offer scalable testbeds for advanced vision-based AI agent training and evaluation.

technical.title: Gemini Decisions API launched for fast and calibrated multimodal decisions
technical.summary: The Gemini Decisions API leverages the Gemini Decision model to deliver rapid, calibrated multimodal decision-making capabilities.
technical.why: It provides developers with streamlined access to state-of-the-art multimodal reasoning models.

business.title: CoreWeave beats revenue expectations and lifts guidance
business.summary: CoreWeave reported Q3 earnings that beat revenue estimates and raised its guidance, easing market concerns regarding an AI slowdown after its stock was heavily hammered.
business.why: Neocloud financial health is a key indicator of ongoing demand for AI compute infrastructure.

business.title: TSMC to invest $1B in Anthropic and OpenAI
business.summary: TSMC is investing $1 billion across Anthropic and OpenAI as an example of circular financing in the AI sector while trade conditions wobble.
business.why: Circular investments between silicon manufacturers and AI labs reveal complex dependencies in the supply chain.

business.title: Data center boom faces real-world hurdles and cancellations
business.summary: The data center boom is encountering local opposition, permitting delays, and electricity shortages, with many announced infrastructure projects potentially never getting built.
business.why: Infrastructure bottlenecks directly impact the scaling and deployment of large-scale AI models.

business.title: Backlash and red tape slow down data center development
business.summary: Data center projects face severe obstacles, including local opposition, permitting delays, and electricity scrambles, raising questions about whether announced infrastructure will be built.
business.why: Power and permitting constraints affect hardware deployment timelines for autonomous driving and large AI systems.

business.title: Nvidia shares rebound as Jensen Huang faces scrutiny
business.summary: Nvidia shares rebounded as investors assessed whether CEO Jensen Huang's affair would cause business spillover effects ahead of the company's earnings report.
business.why: Nvidia's market stability is critical for the entire AI hardware and compute ecosystem.

business.title: Anthropic opens Australian retail IPO offering
business.summary: Anthropic opened its Australian retail IPO offering, enabling individual investors to apply for shares ahead of its broader public market debut.
business.why: Major AI lab public offerings shape market sentiment and capital availability for industry competitors.

business.title: Anthropic seeks record $88.5B in public market debut
business.summary: Anthropic submitted an updated S-1 filing seeking up to $88.5 billion in its IPO and concurrent private placement, marking a massive fundraise tied to a public market debut.
business.why: Massive capital injections into foundation model labs influence compute budgets and industry competitive dynamics.

business.title: Anthropic targets valuation up to $1.4 trillion in IPO
business.summary: Anthropic confirmed its IPO price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share, targeting a valuation as high as $1.4 trillion according to reports.
business.why: Valuation targets for leading AI labs set benchmarks for capital efficiency and market expectations.

business.title: Google DeepMind unveils AlphaGenome 2 for disease research
business.summary: Google DeepMind researchers released AlphaGenome 2, an AI model designed to analyze how DNA variations impact different cells to help identify disease causes and treatments.
business.why: Advances in biological AI models highlight expanding applications of deep learning beyond traditional computer vision.

business.title: Data center backlash centers heavily on electricity constraints
business.summary: Visits to data center hubs like Ashburn, Virginia highlight that local backlash and opposition to massive AI infrastructure projects are fundamentally driven by electricity demands.
business.why: Power availability is a primary physical bottleneck for scaling large AI training and inference data centers.

models.title: Idol Converts Single Images into 3D Gaussian Splats in Seconds
models.summary: Idol turns a single picture of an object into a 3D Gaussian splat containing up to a million Gaussians, including unseen sides. It runs on consumer GPUs using 7.2 GB of VRAM in under two seconds.
models.why: It enables fast, single-image 3D Gaussian splatting on consumer hardware.

models.title: Ripple-65B Preview Introduced with 1 Million Token Context Support
models.summary: Ricursive Intelligence launched Ripple-65B Preview, a 65B parameter dense Transformer pretrained on 12 trillion tokens. It supports up to 1Mi context and scores 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1.
models.why: It delivers high performance on agentic coding compared to much larger models.

models.title: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder Explores Small Language Models for 3D Scene Generation
models.summary: This early preview experiment explores a small 4B language model fine-tuned for general coding with a specific focus on creating interactive 3D scenes using Three.js.
models.why: It tests the feasibility of small language models for specialized 3D graphics coding.

models.title: MiniMax-H3-Image Launches as State-of-the-Art Image Generation and Editing Model
models.summary: MiniMax-H3-Image is an open-source model for text-to-image generation and image editing. It combines intent understanding with precise instruction following to build visual worlds.
models.why: It provides new open-source capabilities for precise image generation and editing.

models.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro Released as a 2.8T Parameter Multimodal Agentic Model
models.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight, natively multimodal agentic model featuring a 1-million-token context window and a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 2.8T total parameters and 104B activated parameters.
models.why: It provides a massive open-weight model with advanced agentic and multimodal capabilities.

models.title: Qwen3.8-27B-TURBO-Fable Fine-Tune Reduces Thinking Tokens While Improving Scores
models.summary: This fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B drastically reduces thinking tokens by half to one-tenth while maintaining output quality, and exceeds key benchmark thresholds in 8-bit and 4-bit quants.
models.why: It significantly speeds up inference reasoning time for a 27B model.
